name: @mozu/configurator
description: RoomMuse configurator: open scans (by code from the phone, sample or file) and furnish them. Deployed as a static site (npm run export) next to the handoff API.

scripts.dev: node scripts/copy-samples.mjs && node scripts/copy-models.mjs && next dev --port 3100
scripts.build: node scripts/copy-samples.mjs && node scripts/copy-models.mjs && next build
scripts.export: node scripts/copy-samples.mjs && node scripts/copy-models.mjs && MOZU_STATIC_EXPORT=1 next build
